name: flauz-environments
description: Flauz environment registry: typed env descriptors (.flauz/environments.json), provider adapters for SSH/container/cloud-sandbox/workspace-remote, connection-plan generation, the env-switch session-continuity model, and the lifecycle behind executors (real local harness, real ssh/docker/cloud providers, simulated drills behind an opt-in).

viewsWelcome.contents:
No Flauz environments registered.
Environments (local, SSH, container, cloud sandbox) live in .flauz/environments.json and carry trust, capabilities and connection plans.
[Refresh Environments View](command:flauz.env.refreshView)
[Back to Flauz Home](command:flauz.focusView.home)

commands.title: Create Environment
commands.description: Provision the lifecycle of a registered environment (creates its backing state; the registry descriptor must exist first).

commands.title: Start Environment
commands.description: Start a created environment (real executors: local harness for workspace-remote, system ssh for ssh-local, system docker for container, cloud HTTP adapter for cloud-sandbox; simulated drills only with the simulated opt-in).

commands.title: Stop Environment
commands.description: Stop a running environment (graceful terminate, then force after a timeout).

commands.title: Attach to Environment
commands.description: Attach to an environment (logical connection lease with provenance; rejected fail-closed for untrusted environments).

commands.title: Detach from Environment
commands.description: Detach from an environment (releases the connection lease).

commands.title: Snapshot Environment
commands.description: Take a real filesystem snapshot of an environment's state (sha256 manifest under .flauz/env-snapshots).

commands.title: Destroy Environment
commands.description: Destroy a stopped environment (terminal; removes its backing state and reaps defensively).

commands.title: Show Environment Status
commands.description: Describe an environment (lifecycle state, health verdict, last operation).

commands.title: Show Continuity Status
commands.description: List continuity bundles and the recorded continuity operations (read-only).

commands.title: Verify Continuity Bundle
commands.description: Verify a continuity bundle's integrity (manifest hashes re-checked against the bundle artifacts, typed per-surface verdicts).

commands.title: Restore Continuity Bundle
commands.description: Restore workspace state from a continuity bundle (destructive-class: requires force to overwrite non-empty state; fail-closed for untrusted target environments).

commands.title: Export Continuity Bundle
commands.description: Export the workspace logical state as a content-addressed continuity bundle under .flauz/continuity-bundles (secret-shaped surfaces are redacted by law, never copied).

flauz.environments.simulated.description: Drive the simulated (TEST INFRASTRUCTURE) executors for the remote kinds by default. The REAL remote executors (ssh-cli, docker-cli, cloud-http) are the default and fail closed with typed errors when the binary/daemon/keys are absent. Per-command { simulated: true } arguments override this setting.

flauz.environments.cloudApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the cloud-sandbox API (the Flauz cloud-sandbox wire contract v0). Empty (default) keeps the cloud-http executor fail-closed: cloud lifecycle ops return the typed CLOUD_UNREACHABLE error instead of fabricating an endpoint. The apiKeyRef still resolves only through the vault-reference port (env:<NAME> or vault:<NAME>); literal keys are rejected at the descriptor schema level.
